children: As BW HOTELIER raises the curtains for the 10th edition of the Indian Hospitality Summit & Awards (IHA) 2026, it will bring that conversation into focus with the theme, “India’s Hospitality Decade: From Growth to Greatness”

India’s hospitality industry is entering a decade of opportunity, expansion and transformation. As the country’s tourism and hospitality ecosystem continues to evolve, the conversation is increasingly moving towards what comes next, how the sector will grow, where that growth will come from, and what will define excellence in the years ahead. As BW HOTELIER raises the curtains for the 10th edition of the Indian Hospitality Summit & Awards (IHA) 2026, it will bring that conversation into focus with the theme, “India’s Hospitality Decade: From Growth to Greatness.”

The theme will set the tone for two days of industry dialogue, bringing together hospitality leaders, investors, developers, policymakers, global voices and experts from across the ecosystem. With “Growth Engines” as the focus for Day 1 and “Greatness in Delivery” for Day 2, the summit will look at both sides of India’s hospitality journey, the forces that will drive growth and the capabilities that will turn that growth into lasting excellence.

Opening the summit today, Shri Brajesh Pathak, Deputy Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, will deliver the Guest of Honour keynote to establish the framework for the two-day event. The first day will further benefit from the presence of Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat, Hon’ble Union Minister of Culture and Tourism, who joins as Chief Guest to engage with the day's key discussions.

Continuing this momentum into Day 2, the gathering will host Shri Anurag Singh Thakur, Member of Parliament and former Union Cabinet Minister for Information & Broadcasting and Youth Affairs & Sports. In addition to sharing his insights, he will preside over the IHA Awards ceremony, recognizing outstanding contribution and leadership across the sector.
A glimpse into IHA 2025

The previous edition of BW HOTELIER IHA brought the industry together under the theme “Atithi Devo Bhava 2.0 – Hosting the World, Shaping the Future.” The ninth edition explored India’s growing role in the global hospitality landscape through conversations around investment, development, policy, operations, technology, workforce and the guest experience.

Across two days, the summit created a platform for hospitality leaders and allied stakeholders to exchange perspectives on the opportunities and challenges shaping the sector. The Awards on the concluding night added another dimension to the gathering, recognising excellence across the hospitality industry through a rigorous and transparent evaluation process.

Additionally, there were two special recognitions at IHA 2025, where BW Hotelier IHA 2025 conferred the Hall of Fame honour on IHCL’s Managing Director and CEO, Puneet Chhatwal and Former President of The Leela Group, Rajiv Kaul, was honoured with the Lifetime Achievement Award.
With IHA 2025 setting the stage for the conversations ahead, the 10th edition will now turn its attention towards the decade ahead for the industry.
Turning the page to BW HOTELIER IHA 2026

“India’s Hospitality Decade: From Growth to Greatness” will be more than a theme for the 10th edition. It will provide the framework for examining how Indian hospitality can move from expansion to scale, and from scale to sustained excellence.

The two-day programme will be divided into two distinct but closely connected themes. Day 1, “Growth Engines,” will focus on leadership, global capital, partnerships, investment, development, market performance and the businesses that will shape the next phase of hospitality. Day 2, “Greatness in Delivery,” will turn towards operations, guest experience, talent, education, design, brand reputation and sustainability.

At the heart of IHA 2026 will be conversations that look beyond individual segments of hospitality to examine the ecosystem as a whole. From global capital and partnerships to investment and development, the first day will examine the foundations of growth. Leadership and business-building conversations will sit alongside market performance and the development pipeline, reflecting the scale of the opportunity and the questions that will accompany it.

The second day will bring the focus closer to execution. Guest experience, hotel operations, talent, education, design, brand reputation and sustainability will form the key strands of the conversation. Together, these discussions will explore what it will take to ensure that growth is not simply achieved, but delivered with consistency and purpose.

The progression from “Growth Engines” to “Greatness in Delivery” will therefore give IHA 2026 a clear narrative — building the capacity for growth and then asking what it will take to deliver greatness across the hospitality experience.
Celebrating Excellence: BW HOTELIER Awards

BW HOTELIER takes pride in ensuring a rigorous and transparent evaluation process for its prestigious awards. The entire process is not only meticulously managed by an esteemed and independent agency but is also guided by the expert judgment of five distinguished juries. At the helm of this esteemed panel is Jury Chair KB Kachru, who is joined by a stellar lineup of National Jury members that includes:
* Veer Vijay Singh, CEO & MD, Trance Hotels
* Farhat Jamal, Chairman - Travel, Tourism and Hospitality Committee, IMC Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Mumbai
* Dilip Puri, Founder & Executive Chairman, Indian School of Hospitality
* Rattan Keswani, Author, Independent Consultant, Former Deputy MD, Lemon Tree Hotels Ltd
* Diwan Gautam Anand - Founding Trustee, Cuisine India Foundation and President, IIHM College of Distinguished Fellows
* Rahul Pandit, MD & CEO, Advent Hotels International
* Rakhee Lalvani, Founder, RLA
* Chef Hemant Oberoi, Chef & Owner, Hemant Oberoi Restaurant, BKC
* Kamal Kant Pant, Principal & Secretary, IHM Pusa, New Delhi
A Four-Zone Judging Process for Complete Transparency
To ensure that every corner of the country’s talent is fairly represented, BW Hotelier has divided the evaluation into four regional juries, each led by experts in their field:

North Zone: Chaired by Suresh Kumar, this panel comprises notable names such as Hemant Mediratta, Naveen Jain, Rifaqat Ali Khan, Samir Kuckreja, Sunil Gupta, Sanjeev K. Nayar, Natwar Nagar, and Chef Parvinder Singh Bali.

West Zone: Under the leadership of Farhat Jamal, this jury features industry veterans such as Antoine Lewis, Chef Hemant Oberoi, Jehangir Aibara, Nisheeth Srivastava, Timmy Kandhari, Rakhee Lalvani, and Ravi Wazir.
South Zone: Headed by Veer Vijay Singh, the panel includes Anand Rao, Chef Chalapathi Rao, Chef Vijaya Baskaran, Dhunji Kavarana, PK Mohan Kumar, and Vinod Valson.
East Zone: Led by Sandip Mukherjee, this esteemed group comprises Dr Pooja Grover, Chef Sharad Dewan, Raja Sadukhan, Kuldeep Bhartee, and Sharada Ghosh.
Bringing the hospitality decade into focus

With the 10th Indian Hospitality Summit & Awards, BW HOTELIER will bring the industry together to look at the decade ahead from both sides of the growth equation. The first day will examine the capital, leadership, development and partnerships that can power India’s hospitality ambitions, while the second will focus on the people, experiences, operations and practices that can turn those ambitions into excellence. From growth engines to greatness in delivery, IHA 2026 will seek to put the next decade of Indian hospitality into perspective, not simply by asking how the sector will grow, but by examining what it will take to make that growth meaningful, sustainable and enduring.
